{{Quote|We have a saying, 'In the darkest hole you can always find some light. You just have to open your eyes to see it.'|[[Goure Conor|Goure]] to [[Tahiri Veila]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ryn''' were an uncommon [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]], with prehensile tails, beak-like [[Nose/Legends|noses]], long fingers, and [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. They were known for their musicality and diligent cleanliness.

==History==
[[File:Rynshot-SV.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Ryn male]]
{{Quote|We're a superstitious folk...|[[Droma]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>}}
They were a nomadic species native to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. They were spread over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], their original [[Ryn homeworld|homeworld]] forgotten, even to them. They had two theories about their origins: the first being that they were descended from thousands of musicians hired out to a world swept clean of artists, the second that they were the descendants of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] deployed against an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] threat. The second gained credence due to the fact that the [[Ryn (language)|Ryn]] contained many military words and phrases, most notably the fact that the words for ''non-Ryn'' and ''civilian'' were related.

Due to their homelessness, musical talent, natural secrecy, and avoidance of written records, Ryn developed a nomadic culture and a reputation for [[Con artist/Legends|confidence games]], leaving many species prejudiced against them. In some [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] it was legal to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] or hunt Ryn. Their language was outlawed in many locations, and a large number of Ryn women were used as slave breeding stock.

The largest concentration of Ryn was located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] due to the fact that it was far from those who would persecute them. Also, a Ryn healer saved the life of a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|CSA]] [[Executive officer/Legends|Executive officer]]. The Ryn claimed to have invented [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], originally as a means of divination. They were a very musical people, being able to play their beak-like noses like flutes. They could even call [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with them, by being able to play pitches very precisely.

<div style="float:right">[[File:Droma_NJOSB.png|thumb|right|180px|[[Droma]], a Ryn]]</div>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a number of Ryn refugees were based on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], and later attempted to settle in [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] following that world's fall. The Ryn ran an [[Ryn Network|information network]] that was second to none. Ultimately the Ryn's actions would result in their reputation improving amongst the Galactic Community.

[[Droma]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] friend and, for a time, co-pilot was a Ryn.

==Behind the scenes==
[[James Luceno]], creator of the Ryn, modelled them after the [[Wikipedia:Romani people|Romany people]]<ref name="tosagents">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/novel/f20001023/index.html|text=Agent of Chaos: An Interview with James Luceno}}</ref> after seeing a documentary on the Romani people's plight throughout history.<ref name="Space Station Liberty">{{WebCite|url=http://terrania.us/libnotes/2007/02/episode-15-james-luceno-interview.html|text=Episode 15 - James Luceno Interview (Part 2)|work=Space Station Liberty|archiveurl=https://archive.is/9vsQo}}</ref>
